parsed.summary: The PR adds an __iter__ method to the Paginator class, which is a logical enhancement. However, it lacks tests to ensure the new functionality works as expected.

issues.description: The PR does not include any tests for the new __iter__ method, which could lead to regressions or unexpected behavior in the future.
